text:
Ruth: Noticed a weird pattern in Orbit 10:04 - multiple scorecards saved as 'draft' after interview even though interviewers clicked Submit. Affects 4 panels this morning.
Dev: Did they get any client error when submitting?
Ruth: No client errors. Local UI shows confirmation but backend draft flag remains.
Mina: Could be the new optimistic-save feature racing with the submit endpoint. We shipped that two hours ago.
Carlos: Quick ask: for upcoming debriefs in 25m can leads manually export candidate score CSVs? We need numbers now.
Ruth: Yes - I'll export and compute averages, but we should avoid manual ops regularly.
Mina: Immediate mitigation: disable optimistic-save for the release channel and add a server-side check that converts drafts to submitted if final_submit_event exists within 2 minutes. I'll open OPS-5344.
Dev: I'll also add a small client metric to tag submit flows where optimistic-save and submit occur within 120s so we can count false-drafts.
Carlos: For hiring ops: if you see a draft that's been open >5m after submit time, ask the interviewer to re-submit or paste screenshot. We'll include a note in the candidate timeline about manual reconciliation.
hiring-bot: Quick training "How to handle draft scorecards" created and posted to #hiring-resources. :bookmark_tabs:
Ruth: Thanks all. Please keep me posted; I'll reconcile the morning panels and update OPS-5344 with examples.
